volumesDeleted: All attached volumes will be permanently deleted.
defaultDate: The default ends one calendar month after creation; the date shown is an estimate until creation. Edit it to choose an exact deadline.
title: Usage schedule
required: Required for all GPU, ≥12 vCPU, ≥64 GiB RAM and administrator-designated flavors. Default: one calendar month.
timezone: Local time zone: {zone}. The server stores UTC.
deleteVolumes: Also permanently delete all attached volumes
destructive: Irreversible: the instance and opted-in volumes will be deleted. Back up anything you need first.
storageScope: Local ephemeral disk is lost on instance deletion. Snapshots, backups, file storage and shared storage are not cleaned up.
reasonHelp: Required for a later date. Up to 255 UTF-8 bytes; no line breaks or control characters.
loadFailed: The schedule could not be loaded. Refresh before making changes.
saveFailed: The schedule could not be saved. Refresh to confirm its current state before trying again.
none: No usage schedule is currently enrolled. Required existing instances receive one calendar month from their first successful enrollment.
readonly: Read-only access. A project writer can extend or change the schedule.
noResume: Extending does not start or restore an archived instance.
locked: An expiry operation is pending, blocked or uncertain. The schedule cannot be edited; refresh and contact an administrator.
empty: No usage reminders for this project.
flavorHelp: GPU / ≥12 vCPU / ≥64 GiB always require a schedule; false or removing this spec cannot exempt them. Set true to add a smaller flavor.
invalidDate: Enter a valid date and time.
pastDate: Choose a future date and time.
shorterDate: A blocked or completed schedule must be extended to a later future expiry.
reasonRequired: Enter a reason for extending usage.
reasonInvalid: Use at most 255 UTF-8 bytes without line breaks or control characters.
invalidConsent: Volume deletion is only available with instance deletion.
beforeStart: Choose an end time after enrollment.
extensionLimit: Each extension may add at most one calendar month to the existing expiry.
extensionLimitHelp: You may shorten a future deadline. Each extension is limited to one UTC calendar month from the current expiry.
reasonFollowup: An unreasonable extension reason may receive a separate follow-up inquiry.
reviewRequired: Extensions require approval by a manager of this domain or an administrator of this exact project.
automatic: Extensions are applied automatically under the current domain policy.
pendingWarning: A pending request does not change the effective expiry or pause expiry actions.
policyHelp: Automatic by default. Only a manager of this domain can require review; changing policy never approves pending requests.
requestsEmpty: No extension requests in this scope.
requestsFailed: Requests could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
policyFailed: Policy could not be loaded. Refresh to confirm it.
operationFailed: The result could not be confirmed. Refresh before another action.
